title: Failure Controller State Route
goal: Prove missing and blocked target results stop at controller decision gates instead of silently accepting work.
completionDefinition: Missing results create no transition candidate; blocked results create an explicit blocked review candidate; stale candidates are rejected.
stagePlan: Stage 0 waits for missing result; Stage 1 imports blocked result; Stage 2 records blocked judgment.

decision.reason: Failure route fixture intentionally records a controller blocker.
